verdict.rationale: Asana's AI Teammates are described as having shared memory that 'learn[s] from the work itself', carrying forward 'every piece of feedback, every preference' so users don't repeat context. That covers preference learning for in-app agents. However, the memory is framed at the team and work-graph level, not as an assistant that adapts to an individual's writing style or shorthand. Missing for 10: explicit learning of personal tone/writing style, shorthand or vocabulary adaptation, per-user personalization controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
